TAL_BERSERKER_RIFT_STRIKE.why: Rift Strike (Berserker): a 100-miles-per-CL rift transport that costs a level of Exhaustion and lands 1d20 miles off an unvisited destination -- travel between places, not a move on the fight's map; nothing in it changes the fight (auto/lane2 2026-09-29).

tianxia.talent.illusion.mirage.why: Mirage (Illusion): a 24-hour illusion over up to a 1-mile cube of terrain that by its text creates no real shelter, bridge, food, water, hazard or Cover -- a ritual-scale scene illusion, not a fight mechanic (auto/lane2 2026-09-29).

tianxia.talent.poison.valley_of_poisonou.why: Valley of Poisonous Immortals (Poison): a 30-day Strategic Project (10 CP committed plus 25,000 gp) that builds a permanent toxic cultivation site with three chosen benefits -- downtime, not a fight mechanic (auto/lane2 2026-09-29).

tianxia.talent.stars.celestial_observato.why: Celestial Observatory (Stars): a 30-day Strategic Project (15 CP plus 25,000 gp) that builds a permanent observatory with three chosen benefits -- downtime, not a fight mechanic (auto/lane2 2026-09-29).

tianxia.talent.thread.hidden_fiber.why: Hidden Fiber (Thread): conceals a mundane Thread Line, anchor, knot, suture or trip line so that a creature needs a Wisdom (Perception) or Intelligence (Investigation) check against the Cultivation Save DC to notice it (1 CP to hide a Qi Thread from ordinary sight) -- a stealth/exploration utility with no fight effect, and the table has no hidden-object noticing check (auto/lane2 2026-09-29).

tianxia.talent.karma.witness_seal.why: Witness Seal (Karma): seals a promise, confession, accusation or bargain as witnessed testimony for 24 hours and tells the caster when the creature contradicts it -- a social record the GM plays, with no effect on the fight itself (auto/lane2 2026-09-29).
